name: Tome of Divinity
summary: A summons bearing the Tome of Divinity calls promising paladins from Elwynn to Stormwind. Answering Brother Wilhelm's call begins the sacred trials needed to master resurrection through the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Summons to the Capital
sections.body: Novice paladins in Elwynn Forest spend their early days helping locals and testing their strength against wolves, Defias bandits, and kobolds. When an initiate shows martial discipline and devotion to the Holy Light, mentors such as Brother Wilhelm send a personal summons. Leaders of the paladins take note of promising students and direct them to leave the local chapels behind and report straight to the kingdom's spiritual heart.

sections.title: The Cathedral of Light
sections.body: In Cathedral Square, Stormwind's Cathedral of Light is the supreme sanctuary of the kingdom's priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand. Duthorian Rall resides there and oversees those sworn to the Order. Beneath its soaring vaulted ceilings, high-ranking paladins set formal trials from the Tome of Divinity before each initiate. The challenges test compassion, fortitude, and a willingness to sacrifice.

faq.q: Who sends me to Stormwind for this quest?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm, the paladin trainer near the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, sends you to Stormwind when you have shown promise and strength in the field.

faq.q: Where can I find Duthorian Rall?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall resides inside the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, in northwestern Stormwind City. He spends most of his days training paladins beneath its grand halls.

faq.q: Why is this summons so important for paladins?
faq.answer: Reporting to Duthorian Rall marks a passage from basic martial training into deep holy communion. The Tome of Divinity's trials begin there and ultimately grant the sacred power to call fallen allies back from death through the Light.

faq.q: Do non-human paladins receive this exact quest?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm's summons from Elwynn Forest is meant for human paladins. Dwarven paladins receive a parallel calling from their own trainers in Dun Morogh to visit Ironforge.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Duthorian Rall?
faq.answer: When you greet Duthorian Rall, he welcomes you to Stormwind and immediately presents the Tome of Divinity's trials, which challenge your compassion and dedication to defending the weak.
Duthorian Rall is among the most influential paladins in Stormwind and the Knights of the Silver Hand. He instructs new generations of holy warriors in the capital.

angles.text: Your mentors formally recognize your deeds and send you before the high commanders of the Silver Hand, marking a rite of passage for paladins.
Your journey from rural Elwynn Forest to the grand Cathedral of Light anchors you to the kingdom's deepest spiritual and martial institutions.
Stormwind's recruitment and testing of holy warriors helps the Alliance keep dedicated frontline healers and combatants through troubled times.
